question: Can I bring a calculator to the placement exam?
page:
Math Placement Exam - Frequently Asked Questions

Q: How long is the placement exam?
A: The exam takes about 90 minutes.

Q: Where is the exam held?
A: Online, through the testing portal, from any quiet location.

Q: Can I retake the exam?
A: Yes, once, after a 30-day wait.

Q: Do I need to study?
A: We recommend reviewing high-school algebra and trigonometry.

Q: When do I get my results?
A: Results appear in your student center within two business days.

Q: Who sees my score?
A: Only you and your academic advisor.

Q: What if I lose my connection?
A: Log back in within 15 minutes to resume where you left off.

Q: Is there a fee?
A: No, the exam is free for admitted students.

Q: Does the score affect my GPA?
A: No. It is used only for course placement.

Q: What browsers are supported?
A: Current versions of Chrome, Firefox and Safari.

Q: Can I use scratch paper?
A: Yes, up to two blank sheets.

Q: May I bring a calculator?
A: A basic four-function calculator is allowed; graphing and scientific calculators are not.
